article.story: DAYTON, Ohio -- — Tristian Ford's 19 points helped Dayton defeat Central Michigan 88-63 on Tuesday. Ford had five rebounds for the Flyers (2-3). Aiden Derkack scored 16 points and added eight rebounds and three steals. Amael L'Etang had 15 points and went 7 of 11 from the field. Conrad Luczynski and Jaxson Whitaker led the way for the Chippewas (4-1) with 12 points each. Dayton took the lead with 18:36 left in the first half and did not trail again. Landen Joseph led his team in scoring with 11 points in the first half to go up 38-27 at the break. Dayton pulled away with a 16-0 run in the second half to extend a 10-point lead to 26 points. They outscored Central Michigan by 14 points in the final half, as Ford led the way with a team-high 12 second-half points. Up next Both teams play Friday. Dayton hosts Utah, and Central Michigan plays Pittsburgh on the road. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
